manifest_issues.explanation: gpu 'H20' (NVIDIA H20) is written with gpu_device 232c:10de, which is NVIDIA H20-3e. NIM matches gpu_device, so these profiles are selected on NVIDIA H20-3e, not on NVIDIA H20.
gpu 'L40S' (NVIDIA L40S) is written with gpu_device 26b5:10de, which is NVIDIA L40. NIM matches gpu_device, so these profiles are selected on NVIDIA L40, not on NVIDIA L40S.
gpu 'RTX5080' is written with gpu_device 2e01:10de, which is not an NVIDIA device id; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 is 2c02:10de. NIM cannot match these profiles on any GPU.
gpu 'RTX5090' is written with gpu_device 2e02:10de, which is 'GB20B [JMJWOA-Generic-GPU]' in pci.ids; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 is 2b85:10de. NIM cannot match these profiles on any GPU.

gpu 'rtx6000-blackwell-sv' is written with gpu_device 2e14:10de, which is not an NVIDIA device id; NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition is 2bb5:10de. NIM cannot match these profiles on any GPU.
'B40' is not an NVIDIA product name in the driver README / pci.ids and has no gpu_device next to it; its profiles are matched by compute capability 12.0.
